test_get_qualification_success: test the TestQualificationDetailsView to verify GET qualification returns HTTP 200 with id, name, description, and creation_date fields
test_get_qualification_not_found: test the TestQualificationDetailsView to verify GET qualification with invalid ID returns HTTP 404 NOT_FOUND
test_patch_qualification_success: test the TestQualificationDetailsView to verify PATCH qualification updates name and description and returns HTTP 200
test_patch_qualification_validation_erro: test the TestQualificationDetailsView to verify PATCH qualification with empty name returns HTTP 400 BAD_REQUEST
test_delete_qualification_success: test the TestQualificationDetailsView to verify DELETE qualification returns HTTP 200 and raises EntryDoesNotExistException on lookup
